hints.title: Offline Query Reorganization
hints.text: Group queries by target node so that answers can be processed during a single tree traversal.

hints.title: Bitwise Prefix Tree with Reference Counts
hints.text: Maintain an 18-bit prefix tree supporting insertions and deletions as nodes enter and leave the active ancestor path.

hints.title: Greedy Bit Inversion Querying
hints.text: At each bit from 17 down to 0, attempt to follow the inverted bit branch to maximize the bitwise difference.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Offline depth-first search using backtrackable bitwise prefix tree.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Querying each node by walking upwards to the root takes O(N * Q) time, causing time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Reference counted prefix tree maintains exact ancestor path in O(B) time per edge.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize grouping queries offline and utilizing a bitwise trie.
